sources.entry: Chobble Tickets - Event ticketing with QR check-in and encrypted attendee records. The complete product is AGPL-3.0 with no open core and no branding requirement, and it runs as an edge script without an always-on server (alternative to Eventbrite). (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 Deno/Docker

summary.one_liner: Chobble Tickets is a self-hostable event and reservation system (Deno, libsql) that encrypts attendee PII at rest and takes payments via Stripe, Square, or SumUp.
summary.what_it_does: Provides listings with fixed or per-date capacity, multi-listing bookings, and a booking form with contact fields and terms agreement. Attendees receive per-ticket URLs with QR codes, and staff use a built-in camera scanner for check-in with ID verification on non-transferable listings. Payments support free and paid listings, deposits, pay-what-you-want pricing, and provider webhooks that create attendees automatically. Attendee PII is encrypted with a hybrid RSA-OAEP and AES-256-GCM scheme, and the admin area covers roles, bulk email, CSV export, activity logs, and wallet passes (Apple and Google). It also offers ICS/RSS feeds, a public and admin JSON API, outbound webhooks, and email notifications via several HTTP providers. The recommended deployment is Bunny Edge Scripting, with Docker and Deno as alternatives.
use_cases: run check-in at a door with QR codes
take reservations for workshops or classes
collect payments and deposits from attendees
embed a booking form on an existing website
how_to_run: Docker: docker run -p 3000:3000 -v tickets-data:/data -e DB_URL="file:/data/tickets.db" -e DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY="your-base64-key" ghcr.io/chobbledotcom/tickets:latest
Local dev: DB_URL=:memory: DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY="$(openssl rand -base64 32)" deno task start
Fork the repo, create a Bunny Database and Bunny Edge Script linked to it, and add DB_URL, DB_TOKEN, DB_ENCRYPTION_KEY, and SCHEDULED_TASK_KEY as script secrets.
Visit /setup/ on first launch to set admin credentials and currency.
notable: Runs as a Bunny Edge Script without an always-on server, with the Deno runtime also available via Docker or standalone
Encrypts attendee PII with a three-layer key hierarchy so a database dump alone cannot reveal personal data
Graded roles including a content-only editor, delivery agent, and door-only scanner
Multi-listing bookings combined into one URL, form, checkout, and webhook
Demo mode replaces user-entered text with generated sample data
caveats: Encryption is unrecoverable if every owner, manager, agent, and scanner password and every API key is lost
Recommended deployment targets Bunny Edge Scripting; Docker image runs on x86-64 hosts only per README
Hosted instances are offered by the author for a fee (£5/month or £50/year); self-hosting is free under AGPL-3.0-only
